title: Organoantimony: a versatile main-group platform for pnictogen-bonding and redox catalysis
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D3CS00332A, Tutorial Review
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Elisa Chakraborty, Robin Weiss
This Tutorial Review delves into the fundamental principles underpinning the reactivity of organoantimony compounds, elucidating their prospective roles in non-covalent interactions, organometallic transformations, and redox catalysis.
